import numpy as np
def equation(t,P,params):
    p=params
    q=P/(1+P)
    return (p[0]+p[1]*P+p[2]*P**2+p[3]*P**3+p[4]*q
            +p[5]*t+p[6]*t**2+p[7]*t**3
            +p[8]*t*q+p[9]*t**2*q
            +0.0*t*P*np.exp(-P))
